releases.name: Release v2.5.0
releases.body:
Phase 11 autonomy wiring. Machine-signed stage transitions move headless
runs through allowed stages on `integration/*` and `factory/*` branches
without a passphrase at each exit (ADR 0004, human acceptance pending);
green integration branches land on `staging/autonomous` with the human
release veto enforced; the canary runs behind explicit human enablement;
the self-dogfood preset turns on the mutation gate and model-diversity
refusal. Releases, `main` targets, trust, waivers and key operations stay
human-only for good. The published trio releases in lockstep as 2.5.0.

**What is reachable in this release.**

- Reachable: machine-signed stage exits in factory + headless runs (#344);
  staging land + suites + unsigned-cut veto with terminal countersign (#345);
  scheduler canary seam behind opt-in (#346); preset Goodhart defaults (#347).
- Human-only surface: ADR 0004 acceptance, terminal countersign, canary
  enablement, and the 2.5.0 publish itself.

releases.name: v2.3.0: phases 6–9, first release since 1.6.0
releases.body:
Phase 9 recursive self-improvement & model distillation. This release adds
a prompt optimizer, a trajectory exporter for local-model training data and
a canary hot-swap harness — every loop fail-closed and human-gated by
construction: nothing rewrites prompts, weights or shipped code without a
recorded human approval, and the canary stays OFF until a human explicitly
enables it. The published trio (core/CLI/plugin) releases in lockstep as
2.3.0.

2.3.0 is the first published release since 1.6.0. Versions 1.6.1, 2.0.0,
2.1.0 and 2.2.0 were merged but never tagged or published; everything in
their entries below ships as part of 2.3.0.

**What is reachable in this release.** Several Phase 6–9 pieces are library
APIs with tests that no factory, CLI or daemon path calls yet. They are
inert until wired:

- Reachable: `es improve export-dataset` (#175), `es rebase cascade` (#165),
  `es worktree prune` and startup orphan GC (#160), the opt-in mutation gate
  (#169), the model-diversity check (#170) and the benchmark suite (#171).
- Library only, not called: the prompt optimizer (#174), the machine key and
  proof-carrying transitions (#164), the staging pipeline (#166) and lease
  acquisition through `WorktreeLeaseManager` (#160). Stage exits still need
  the human passphrase.
- Not in the npm packages: `es-fleet run-dag` (#161) and the canary harness
  (#176) live in the private `packages/fleet`.

**Behaviour changes.**

- **#174: Evolutionary prompt & cognitive strategy optimizer.**
  `generatePromptCandidates` (`packages/core/src/improve/optimizer.ts`)
  turns telemetry failure clusters into targeted prompt variations
  (append-guidance, trim-bloat, multi-generation combine); `evolvePrompts`
  grades each against the benchmark suite and keeps only strict Pareto
  winners (zero regressions plus a strictly better pass rate or lower
  spend/steps). Winners become review-only proposal dirs with before/after
  benchmark receipts; `applyPromptPatch` is the sole applier and refuses
  without a matching recorded human approval. Signal-free telemetry yields
  no candidates and vacuous baselines are refused.
- **#175: Synthetic trajectory harvester for distillation.**
  `harvestTrajectories` captures multi-turn trajectories of passed, verified
  phase worktrees only (green gate summaries plus a non-vacuous audit chain,
  derived by `es improve export-dataset` from on-disk evidence); every
  string is secret-scrubbed, diffs are path- and existence-verified, and
  unverified/missing/escaping inputs are skipped with reasons. Exports
  Unsloth/Axolotl/HF-compatible chat JSONL (`sft`) and prompt/chosen/rejected
  pairs (`dpo`, never inventing negatives) with a provenance manifest.
- **#176: Canary self-compilation and hot-swap harness.**
  `CanaryRunner` (`packages/fleet/src/canary.ts`) builds candidates in an
  isolated staging sandbox, shadow-tests them beside the live worker, and
  atomically re-points the active symlink only when green — rolling back
  instantly when red. OFF by default: construction without `enabled: true`
  and a recorded human approval throws. The rollback target is frozen at
  construction, guarded writes deny the rollback tree and the active link,
  and candidates built inside the rollback tree are refused.

**Security.**

- No autonomous path rewrites prompts, weights or shipped code: the
  optimizer and canary apply only under recorded human approvals, and the
  canary pipeline seam has no silent defaults.
- Distillation datasets are secret-scrubbed (token families, credentials,
  private-key blocks) with redaction counts; DPO export refuses to invent
  rejected responses.
- Test fixtures build fake secrets by interpolation (repo precedent) so
  static scanners never see credential-like literals.

releases.name: v0.7.25: 09-parity-closure (W20-W22 pins + D3 smoke script)
releases.body:
Hardening-backlog 09-parity-closure follow-up (B1 06-parity closure only, B2 D3 included, B3 full dual QA, B4 patch release).

- P1: W20/W21/W22 waiver pins re-verified non-vacuous (revert-mutation fails each pin; verdicts as waived; triggers unmet).
- P2: D3 live TUI smoke formalized as reproducible script (.roadmap/09-parity-closure/d3-smoke.md, pinned 0.7.24+) + user-run log slot; live execution remains user acceptance at sign-off.
- Docs-only: zero source bytes changed. gen_schemas / build_adapters / check_docs green; 728-test full suite green; four-manifest lockstep (gemini extension independent per AGENTS.md).

Factory phase 01-nk-hardening (brainstorm-nk-hardening run): shared NK crash hardening. Defensive rendering + ingest normalization, pcrb/store/refinement guards, full-key dedupe, prompt contracts, 49 malformed-NK pins. Suite 728/728 green. W1-W6 waived with triggers.
